en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a large Romanesque cathedral with a distinctive dome and bell tower, accompanied by a central public fountain adorned with statues, in a broad open square. The structure and the fountain are framed by old-fashioned street lamps, classic automobiles, people, and trees. The bottom of the image contains the words 'TRENTO - Il Duomo' and the number 20.
